<module id="multi_pipe_4bit">
    <description>Design a pipelined multiplier for 4-bit numbers. The multiplier has two levels of registers to store intermediate values and control the multiplication process.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal for synchronization.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Active-low reset signal.</input>
        <input id="mul_a" width_description="[3:0]">Multiplicand input signal.</input>
        <input id="mul_b" width_description="[3:0]">Multiplier input signal.</input>
        <output id="mul_out" width_description="[7:0]">Product output signal.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <param>size = 4</param>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="combinational_logic">
        <assign id="mul_a_ext">{{size{1'b0}}, mul_a}</assign>
        <assign id="mul_b_ext">{{size{1'b0}}, mul_b}</assign>
    </logic_description>
    
    <logic_description type="combinational_logic">
        genvar i;
        generate
            for(i=0;i<size;i=i+1) begin : gen_loop
                assign id="partial_product_" + {i}>({(2*size){1'b0}}+(mul_a_ext & {{size{i[3]}}, mul_b_ext[i]}));
            end
        endgenerate
        
        <reg id="register_partial_sum_[i]" width_description="[7:0]">Register to store the partial sum for each stage.</reg>
        
        // Register Partial Sum Logic Description
        <always @("posedge clk or negedge rst_n")>begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                register_partial_sum_[0] <= 'd0;
            end else begin
                register_partial_sum_[0] <= partial_product_0;
            end
        end
        <always @("posedge clk or negedge rst_n")>begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                register_partial_sum_[1] <= 'd0;
            end else begin
                register_partial_sum_[1] <= partial_product_1 + register_partial_sum_[0];
            end
        end
        <always @("posedge clk or negedge rst_n")>begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                register_partial_sum_[2] <= 'd0;
            end else begin
                register_partial_sum_[2] <= partial_product_2 + register_partial_sum_[1];
            end
        end
        <always @("posedge clk or negedge rst_n")>begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                register_partial_sum_[3] <= 'd0;
            end else begin
                register_partial_sum_[3] <= partial_product_3 + register_partial_sum_[2];
            end
        end
        <always @("posedge clk or negedge rst_n")>begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                register_partial_sum_[4] <= 'd0;
            end else begin
                register_partial_sum_[4] <= register_partial_sum_[3];
            end
        end
        <always @("posedge clk or negedge rst_n")>begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                register_partial_sum_[5] <= 'd0;
            end else begin
                register_partial_sum_[5] <= register_partial_sum_[4];
            end
        end
    </logic_description>
    <logic_description type="combinational_logic">
        <assign id="mul_out">register_partial_sum_[5];</assign>
    </logic_description>
</module>
